[F006] Repo: DontPanic  
Env: dev  
Project: (none)

Overall verdict: needs_changes. The implementer’s Repo/Env/Project declaration matches structured context, and its five recorded commands contain no forbidden or missing-required-flag shapes. The mocked CLI contract also matches [Buzz’s implementation](https://github.com/block/buzz/blob/main/crates/buzz-cli/src/commands/messages.rs#L455-L464).

FINDING (high, security): Buzz’s native `nsec1…` private keys are not redacted from notification content. Evidence: `_sanitize` relies on `SECRET_REGEXES`, which has no Nostr-key pattern; the adversarial check returned `nostr_private_key_redacted=False`. Recommendation: add a sourced Nostr secret-key rule to the central scrubber—also consider labeled 64-character hex private keys—and add runtime redaction tests.

FINDING (medium, security): Windows home-path redaction is case-sensitive. Evidence: `C:\Users\Alice\…` was redacted, but equivalent `c:\users\Alice\…` remained unchanged. Recommendation: match Windows paths case-insensitively with either slash separator and add regression coverage.

The in-memory configured/absent fan-out and existing GitHub-token/home-path regressions passed. Ruff, sanitization over 3,506 files, and diff checks passed. Pytest could not start because the read-only auditor sandbox provides no writable temporary directory.
